caption: Jesus fits the wider Christian reading of Psalm 2’s king. But the title “king” is shared by countless rulers and cannot identify him by itself.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 2 predict Jesus as King? God installs His king on Zion. Matthew’s visitors later ask for the newborn King of the Jews.
